text:
Evan: quick heads-up — prod telemetry shows a steady stream of requests where the client `x-api-version` header does not match the runtime route. Some customers are getting billed against v2 quotas even though fallback served v1-compatible responses. thinking about an automated detection -> autocohort flow to protect billing. cc @Rohan @Jess
Rohan: can you paste an example of the mismatch log?
Evan: sure, sample from last hour:```[WARN] req_id=abc123 client=acme-co header_version=v2 route_version=v1 route_response_time=120ms billing_route=v2_detected=false```
Jess: ugh. Is this from clients actually sending wrong headers or our routing layer?
Evan: mixed — some are headers lost in proxy chain, some are SDKs with stale defaults. we get noisy signals (short bursts) and long tails.
ConsoleBot: automated alert: "version_signal_entropy" spike detected on tier=standard - 5m avg > 0.02
Emily: two quick concerns: 1) autocohorting could misclassify transient noise and lock customers into wrong quotas; 2) metric cardinality — we can't explode billing keys.
Tara: UX idea: show a temporary console badge "Version mismatch detected — Safeguard Enabled" with an action "Review and Confirm". default safeguard = hold billing changes for 24h and shadow-charge for telemetry. :shield:
Rohan: technical sketch: detect when header mismatch rate > threshold T over window W for a token, then put token into an "autocohort" where we route as currently but tag requests with `billing_safe=true` and record `shadow_billing` events. If mismatch persists for 48h and human review passes, escalate to pin route. pseudocode: ```if mismatch_rate(token, W) > T: set_cohort(token, "safeguard"); annotate_requests(token, {"billing_safe":"true","mismatch_window":W})```
Jess: we should avoid adding new billing time-series per token. proposal: keep a binary tag `billing_safe` and aggregate a single metric `billing_safe_traffic_tokens` with token_count bucketed by tenant tier.
Emily: sampling is key. start with 0.5% of affected tokens for aggressive autocohort, plus shadow-billing logs for the rest. we can increase if signal looks clean.
Evan: agreement on sampling. also add a telemetry counter `version_mismatch_confirmed` and `version_mismatch_false_positive` so we can compute precision.
Tara: console affordance details: show timeline of mismatch signal, last 72h, with quick actions: "enable safeguard", "request human review", "ignore". default should be opt-out (safeguard on) for new detections.
Rohan: operational constraints: SLA-backed Dedicated customers shouldn't be auto-shifted without a manual opt-in. add policy: if customer_has_SLA == true -> notify account owner and set `pending_safeguard` (no automatic billing flags).
Jess: billing pipeline change: allow `billing_safe=true` annotation to bypass quota reclassification for up to X tokens/day. we also need a backfill script to reconcile shadow charges into real invoices if customer confirms.
Evan: proposal for experiment: rollout autocohort on a shadow namespace for 2 weeks: 1) detect candidates, 2) mark `billing_safe` in traces, 3) shadow-bill and emit reconciliation artifacts. if false positive rate < 3% and ops overhead < 1hr/day -> enable safeguard for 5% sample.
ConsoleBot: new task created: #ops-4456 "autocohort mismatch detection experiment" (assignee: Rohan)
Emily: logging note: redact token IDs in logs, emit hashed tenant id for dedup but keep samples at full fidelity behind secure audit flow.
Tara: small copy ask for console: "We detected atypical version signals for your requests. We placed a temporary billing safeguard to prevent quota surprises. Review recommended."
Rohan: action items: 
- Rohan: implement detector + 0.5% sampling + shadow-billing (ETA 3d)
- Jess: update billing pipeline to honor `billing_safe` tag and provide reconciliation hook (ETA 5d)
- Tara: mock console badge + copy for review (ETA 2d)
- Emily: add telemetry counters + dashboard panel (ETA 2d)
Evan: quick wins: add high-cardinality guard rails to detector so we don't create per-token time series, and keep the console flow explicit. I'll draft the runbook for ops.
Jess: one more thought — add a TTL on `billing_safe` (24h default) and require explicit confirm to extend. prevents stale safe tags.
Evan: agreed. ok let's move to threads for implementation. thanks all :rocket:
Tara: :thumbsup:
